summary: mTLS to an external database is off by default; enable per component with *_pg_cert_auth=true, *_pg_tls_cert, *_pg_tls_key and *_pg_sslmode=verify-full, each with its own certificate.
questions: How do I configure mTLS for the AAP external database?
Can AAP components share a database client certificate?

answer_card.title: mTLS to an external database
answer_card.answer_md:
Per component (`gateway`, `controller`, `hub`, `eda`), in `[all:vars]`:
```ini
controller_pg_cert_auth=true
controller_pg_tls_cert=/path/to/awx.cert
controller_pg_tls_key=/path/to/awx.key
controller_pg_sslmode=verify-full
```
Use a different cert and key for each component.
